areas.name: products
areas.doc: The Products tab: the whole catalogue read page by page, and the product list with its units and revenue by month, stock and facets. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit), where it sat in the stock bridge's section without reading anything of the bridge's; its routes, the list and a product's page, are in gizmo/routes/products.py. Read as `catalog.NAME` (`products` is a local name in several functions).

routes.name: routes_products
routes.doc: The Products tab's routes: the product list and a product's page. Gathered from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where the first stood; their paths are literal, so no request changes hands.
routes.register_doc: Add the Products tab's routes to the app.
routes.comment: The Products tab's routes (gizmo/routes/products.py), gathered where the first stood.
